description: ANTfrastructure's own Renovate config. Everything that is not specific to THIS repo now lives in the shared preset at the repository root (default.json), so the consumers get the same rules by extending one line - most importantly the git-submodules manager, which Renovate disables by default and which is why this repo's own third_party/DocumANTation pin went unwatched.

Renovate resolves `github>Kataglyphis/ANTfrastructure` from the DEFAULT BRANCH even for this repository, so a default.json change is not exercised by the PR that makes it; it takes effect after merge.

packageRules.description: versions.env keys are notification-only by DEFAULT: most bumps are coupled to a paired *_SHA256/*_COMMIT in the same file or to a source patch, so they keep the human ritual (AGENTS.md § Version Bumping). Matched by FILE, not by manager id, so it holds for the local CLI's report (manager 'regex') and the platform's ('custom.regex') alike.

Self-contained keys the local CLI may apply: the version moves alone (no paired value in versions.env goes stale) and the tool or package installs at run time. Everything else keeps the approval rule above.
Dockerfile digest updates (UBUNTU_DIGEST-style FROM pins) also need sync_versions.py --write to propagate; require dashboard approval.
NODE_VERSION may only move within its major: the image tail and the tools built on it are validated per major (bump_versions.py SAFE tier: same-major only).
PYTHON_VERSION may only move within its minor: the CPython source build and its patch set are re-verified per minor (bump_versions.py SAFE tier: same-minor only).
WIX_VERSION / WIX_UI_EXT_VERSION stay on WiX 4: a WiX major changes the CLI/authoring model, which is why bump_versions.py same-major-locks them.
PY_SETUPTOOLS_LT82_VERSION is capped for the torch wheelhouse: only candidates below 82 are offered. Scoped by currentValue so PY_SETUPTOOLS_VERSION keeps seeing the newest release.

customManagers.description: versions.env keys annotated with a renovate hint comment: # renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<name> [extractVersion=...]
Digest pins: the hint carries the tag, the KEY= line under it the sha256. The docker datasource then reports when that tag's digest moves.

cuda.description: NVIDIA's CUDA redist index: the html fetcher turns every href into a candidate, and the transform strips the redistrib_/.json wrapper so the version is written in the shape the key already carries.

vulkan.description: LunarG's latest.json. The WINDOWS value, deliberately: VULKAN_VERSION feeds both lanes and LunarG ships Windows last, so the Windows entry is the one that exists everywhere (the bump_versions.py spec takes the oldest of linux/windows for the same reason).

nuget.description: dist.nuget.org's tool manifest: every nuget.exe ever, tagged with its release stage. ReleasedAndBlessed only, exactly what bump_versions.py spec_nuget filters on.
